profiles.label: Connect your paired OpenMausBot instance
permissionDescription: Discover bots visible to your paired session
Send messages in the existing vendor conversation with approval mode Ask
Read streamed replies and history
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the token from a separately paired OpenMausBot client. Allternit stores it encrypted and checks bot access before connecting. Pair with the OpenMausBot instance running on your connected computer.

profiles.label: Connect your Codync host
permissionDescription: Discover the bots on your connected Codync computer
Message the vendor bot in its existing conversation
Read replies and forward explicit one-time human approvals
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the local host token for the Codync instance running on your connected computer. Allternit stores it encrypted. Bots must use Ask for permission; persistent grants are not forwarded.

profiles.label: Connect your Hivekeep API client
permissionDescription: Discover agents allowed by your API client
Create isolated conversations and send messages
Read the matching request reply
profiles.credentialDescription: Create an API client in Hivekeep with isolated conversation access. Use its hk_ key for the instance on your connected computer. Allternit stores the key encrypted. Review tool approvals in Hivekeep.

profiles.label: Connect your Invisible Dots server
permissionDescription: Discover the Dots on your connected computer
Send messages in the existing Dot conversation
Read replies matched to your vendor message
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the API token for the Invisible Dots server on your connected computer. Allternit stores it encrypted. Queued messages wait for a matched reply. Review tool approvals in Invisible Dots.

profiles.label: Connect your OpenDots runtime
permissionDescription: Discover the Dots in your OpenDots workspace
Create an isolated conversation for Allternit
Run the vendor Dot through its configured CopilotKit Intelligence connection
profiles.credentialDescription: Configure an owner access token in your OpenDots instance and use that token here. CopilotKit Intelligence must already be configured in the vendor app. Allternit stores the token encrypted. Review approvals in OpenDots.

profiles.label: Connect your DS Bot instance
permissionDescription: Discover DS Bots in your DSH instance
Send messages to existing bot conversations and receive matched replies
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the 43-character launch token from your own DSH Web instance. Configure its loopback origin with SUBS_GATEWAY_DS_BOT_URL on your Sessions computer and select each bot’s model in DSH first.

profiles.label: Connect your OpenMuse runtime
permissionDescription: Use the live agent configured in your OpenMuse runtime
Send messages and receive replies in a new conversation
profiles.credentialDescription: Use your runtime’s OPENMUSE_ACCESS_KEY. OpenMuse must run in live mode with its agent configured. Conversation history lasts for this gateway session.

profiles.label: Connect your OpenBot desktop host
permissionDescription: Discover your OpenBot agents
Send messages to existing bot conversations and receive matched turn replies
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the sessionToken returned by your host’s local Team API login. Configure its runtime-assigned loopback port with SUBS_GATEWAY_OPENBOT_NIGHTLY_URL on your Sessions computer.

profiles.label: Connect your Rakazo account
permissionDescription: Discover bots in your selected Rakazo space
Send messages to existing threads and receive replies from the matching run
profiles.credentialDescription: Enter JSON with your own Better Auth bearer session and selected space: {"token":"your session token","spaceId":"your space ID"}. Configure the API origin with SUBS_GATEWAY_RAKAZO_URL on the gateway runtime.

profiles.label: Connect a FrockBot deployment you administer
permissionDescription: Discover the bots of your FrockBot admin account
Send turns to those bots and receive the matching run reply
profiles.credentialLabel: FrockBot debug token and admin user
profiles.credentialDescription: For self-hosted deployments you administer. Enter JSON: {"token":"your DEBUG_TOKEN","userId":"your admin user ID"}. The gateway runtime needs SUBS_GATEWAY_FROCKBOT_URL and SUBS_GATEWAY_FROCKBOT_DEBUG_ENABLED=1. Use a dedicated deployment: this token can read other accounts on it.

profiles.label: Connect Sidemates on your Sessions computer
permissionDescription: Discover your Sidemates teammates
Send messages to a teammate’s thread and receive the reply from that run
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the access token from your Sidemates data folder or a paired device key. Configure its loopback address with SUBS_GATEWAY_SIDEMATES_URL on your Sessions computer.

profiles.label: Connect nanoMuse running on your Sessions computer
permissionDescription: Use the agent served by nanomuse serve
Start new conversations and receive its final replies
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the token in your nanoMuse data folder (server_token). Run nanomuse serve and configure its loopback address with SUBS_GATEWAY_NANOMUSE_URL. The phone app is not supported.

profiles.label: Connect your Vellum assistant
permissionDescription: Read your assistant’s identity
Send messages and receive the reply to each request
profiles.credentialDescription: Pair a client with your assistant runtime and paste its token. Configure the runtime’s loopback address with SUBS_GATEWAY_VELLUM_ASSISTANT_URL. Tokens are short-lived; pair again when it expires.

profiles.label: Text Iris from your Mac
permissionDescription: Send texts to Iris from your Messages app
Read Iris’s replies to those texts
profiles.credentialLabel: Assistant phone number or iMessage address
profiles.credentialDescription: Allternit texts Iris from your own number using Messages on your Sessions computer (a Mac). Enter JSON {"handle":"+1..."} with the number you text Iris at. Requires SUBS_GATEWAY_MESSAGES_ENABLED=1 and Full Disk Access for the gateway so it can read replies.

profiles.label: Connect your Gawkbot office
permissionDescription: Discover your Gawkbot office members
Message a member and receive its reply
profiles.credentialDescription: Use the broker token from Gawkbot on your Sessions computer; set its address with SUBS_GATEWAY_GAWKBOT_URL. Terminal-session members show as unavailable; other office members can be messaged.

profiles.label: Connect Open Dots on your Sessions computer
permissionDescription: Start Open Dots tasks
Read each task’s result
profiles.credentialDescription: Enter your Open Dots user_id. Open Dots has no access control of its own, so Allternit only connects to it on this computer (SUBS_GATEWAY_OPENDOTS_ANIL_URL, loopback). Its backend needs LOCAL_EXECUTION_ENABLED=true. Approvals stay in Open Dots.

profiles.label: Connect your Munder Difflin floor
permissionDescription: Send tasks to your Munder Difflin floor
Read each task’s result
profiles.credentialDescription: Enable a webhook endpoint in Munder Difflin and enter JSON {"endpointId":"…","secret":"…"}. Messages go to the floor’s orchestrator, not a chosen agent.

profiles.label: Connect your Happy account
permissionDescription: See your active Happy sessions
Send messages into a session and read the agent’s reply
profiles.credentialDescription: Enter JSON {"secret":"…"} with your Happy account’s restore secret (Happy → Settings → Account). Messages stay end-to-end encrypted; Allternit decrypts them with your key on the gateway.

profiles.label: Connect your OpenBot workspace
permissionDescription: Discover your OpenBot bots
Send messages in new threads and receive replies
profiles.credentialDescription: Enter JSON {"origin":"https://your-openbot-host","sessionToken":"…"} using the better-auth.session_token from your own signed-in OpenBot.
